text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the world—once again. At the 
Hong Kong racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The opposition is—top-tier. Winners of 
overseas GⅠ races lined up one after 
another."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(There's a Hong Kong Derby Umamusume... 
And an Irish Derby Umamusume as well.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(The rivals here might be even fiercer 
than the ones in Dubai. But—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I am not who I was before. And my 
"strategy"—knows no borders.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A crushing victory! A blowout so decisive 
it will silence everyone! Just watch—the 
world will be mine.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rulership with a decent start! She's 
secured an ideal position.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Smoothly holding on to 3rd place! Showing 
remarkable composure!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I can see it! Everything...! 
Perfectly...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(This race without a doubt... will be my 
best race yet!!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Final stretch... Still too early. 
However—everything is within 
expectations.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'm making my move right here! 
Daaaahhhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rulership is so strong! Rulership is 
unstoppable! Rulership, could this be?!?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The world is in the palm of my handdd!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my word...! Unbelievable!! Rulership 
wins in an overwhelming victory!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... How strange. Even after such a 
satisfying victory, my heart remains calm.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yet this is it. This is what I was 
seeking— a flaw-free victory born of pure 
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The sensation in my limbs—it's expanding. 
Yes, today, I am—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The board itself. The other Umamusume were 
merely dancing on top of me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day, Rulership was practically 
divine. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From this point, the Rulership Gang's 
unstoppable advance began.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's time to announce the Team 
Ranking results!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Tracen Academy, though unofficial, 
there are annual rankings for each team.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, as the one in charge of the 
Rulership team, I was looking after all 
the members who had gathered.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now entering their second year, Trainer <username>'s 
team is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
12th place! Unbelievable, she's suddenly 
ranked in at 12th!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That victory in Hong Kong really 
made an impact. We've got a great lineup 
assembled.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe and the others finished 
in—13th place.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You got passed by Rulership, huh. Truly 
"TRGDY"...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best again next year.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We're in... 8th place... But we can't just 
take it easy...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My "friend" is telling me. Rulership-san 
is a different person...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"My, so you are a resident of another 
world. I can somehow sense it."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, impressive, impressive. Coming right 
out swinging, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What are you going to do, Journey? I'm in 
3rd place, but they might overtake you 
before long.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Even I... can't laugh at this, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I wonder... what next year will bring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And... one year later.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold's team is in 4th place! And 
Trainer <username>'s team is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: 8th place!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
She's steadily creeping up the ranks even 
further!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, Stay Gold-san. Next year, we 
will—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"We might end up stuck on the same space. 
Looking forward to working with you."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, that sounds good too. Don't hold 
back at all—go wild out there!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I've actually taken quite a liking to you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Huh, even though you're being chased?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Like I care. I mean... if you look back at 
our journey, you'd understand, right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Struggling to find success after his 
debut, he went on to achieve a dramatic GⅠ 
victory in Hong Kong—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even in team battles, despite not drawing 
much attention, they put up a good fight.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't feel like a stranger to me. 
Somehow, she gives off a familiar vibe.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I am honored... let us put it that way. 
Now then, shall we aim even higher as we 
compete?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The ones dominating the top positions 
right now are...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah, the one positioned ahead of us is...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The top two are an undisputed powerhouse 
duo. Over the past few years—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No team has managed to break into their 
ranks. They really feel like an unyielding 
bedrock, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I see, an unyielding bedrock... However—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The stronger they are, the more rewarding 
they are to conquer.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, right now, I am trembling to my 
core.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Because of how immensely fun this board 
game called the Twinkle Series is.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—“To rule over history.” Easy to say, but 
far from simple to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That historical timeline has its rises and 
falls— and a massive comeback from the 
back roads is entirely possible.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You'd want to seize it too, wouldn't you? 
The throne of history's ruler.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna laugh. With you, standing right 
at the apex of this 3D board."
choice_data_list: Yeah, I want to win—as a gamer.
Yeah, I want to win—as a gamer.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Before my debut, I never could have 
imagined that the Twinkle Series was a 
game of such incredible depth.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However, right now, I'm completely 
absorbed. I want to keep playing this game 
with you forever.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I had plenty of flaws, but I aimed for the 
day I would rule over history. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Board games are fun precisely because 
they're played on hard mode!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Vying for the throne of ruler. In the 
light, in the shadows, the game of the 
Umamusume continues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"God does not play dice." While that is 
the common belief――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the world of Umamusume, that isn't 
necessarily the case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon the eternal, never-ending board, 
Rulership is still weaving his strategies 
to this day.
